text: Contract-before-edit for Quest Q6 (table-policy-outstanding-read-currency): Producer/Consumer symbols: Producers are TablePolicyService.updateTablePolicy, writePolicyConditionally, recordCommittedPolicyFence, commitPolicyFenceAfterWrite, advanceTablePolicyCurrencyFromObservation; Consumers are PriorityPublicationSafetyRows.getCriticalMinReplicaCount, TablePolicyService.getTablePolicy, resolveServiceTablePolicyFact, resolveServicePartitionPolicyFact. Owner-defined shape: Policy currency entry payload {table_policies, updated_at, created_at, table_incarnation, version, supersededSnapshots, minWitnessTerm, minWitnessAppliedIndex}. Identity/Generation: Bound to tableId and table creation incarnation (created_at/table_incarnation). Policy revisions monotonically advance version and updated_at. Monotonic ordering: older witness positions or older creation incarnations are rejected as superseded. Absent vs Unavailable: Authoritative absence (AUTHORITATIVE_ABSENCE, TABLE_ABSENT) returns zero rows under valid leader witness; typed unavailability (UNAVAILABLE_OR_STALE, TABLE_UNAVAILABLE or STALE_EVIDENCE) occurs on transport failure, witness lag, or in-flight invalidation/eviction. Durable commit: single-row CAS mutation confirmed via requireConfirmedSingleRowMutation. Retained obligations & cleanup: active read tokens are pruned on completion; currency entries and superseded snapshots are bounded to MAX_COMMITTED_POLICY_FENCES and MAX_SUPERSEDED_POLICY_SNAPSHOTS; deletion/eviction marks active reads evicted and invalidated.

Preserve policy currency for all outstanding reads across retirement, eviction, deletion, and recreation: 1) Added creation incarnation (created_at/table_incarnation) tracking in buildCurrencyEntryPayload, buildUpdatedCurrencyEntry, advanceTablePolicyCurrencyFromObservation, and commitPolicyFenceAfterWrite; 2) Enforced incarnation fence in isSupersededByCommittedPolicyFence and isRowStrictlyNewerThanCurrency so reads from prior table incarnations cannot resurrect policy after recreation; 3) Fixed ABA/content recurrence leak in isInvalidatedRowStaleAgainstCurrency by removing faulty matching-content bypass for invalidated in-flight reads; 4) Updated deleteTablePolicy, clearCache, invalidateCache, and absence observation in table-policy-resolution.js to mark active in-flight reads invalidated and evicted, guaranteeing that stale in-flight reads cannot resurrect deleted table policies; 5) Preserved PriorityPublicationSafetyRows.getCriticalMinReplicaCount schedule: verified that holding old min 3 read while committing 5 then 7, consuming fresh 7, and releasing old 3 rejects old read as STALE_EVIDENCE and preserves cached minimum 7; 6) Bound resource lifecycles with zero token leaks and strict capacity limits.
